Based on the operative description, the likely CPT coding would be:

| CPT Code | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **22558** | Arthrodesis, anterior interbody technique, including minimal discectomy to prepare interspace; lumbar | For the **L5-S1 anterior lumbar interbody fusion/revision ALIF**. Includes the disk space preparation/discectomy necessary for fusion. |
| **22853** | Insertion of interbody biomechanical device, with integral anterior instrumentation for device anchoring when performed, to intervertebral disc space in conjunction with interbody arthrodesis | For placement of the **4WEB textured titanium interbody device/cage** at L5-S1. |
| **22845** | Anterior instrumentation; 2 to 3 vertebral segments | Report if the **anterior buttress plate/screw construct** is separate anterior instrumentation spanning/anchoring L5-S1 and not merely integral fixation built into the cage. |
| **20930** | Allograft, morselized, or placement of osteopromotive material, for spine surgery only | For **BMP sponges/manufactured bone graft**, if payer allows separate reporting. Many payers bundle or have specific policies for BMP/biologic graft material. |

### Possible/Conditional Coding Considerations

| CPT Code | Description | When to Consider |
|---|---|---|
| **22558-62** | Co-surgery modifier | If an access/vascular/general surgeon performed the anterior retroperitoneal exposure and a spine surgeon performed the fusion, both surgeons may report **22558 with modifier -62**, assuming documentation supports distinct co-surgeon work. There is generally **no separate CPT code just for anterior spine exposure**. |
| **22899** | Unlisted procedure, spine | May be considered only if the removal of the prior posteriorly placed TLIF PEEK cage was unusually extensive and not adequately represented by the revision ALIF work. Many carriers will consider cage removal inherent to the revision fusion/discectomy unless separately justified. |

### Codes Generally Not Separately Reported

| Service | Coding Comment |
|---|---|
| **Completion diskectomy** | Included in **22558** when performed to prepare the interspace for fusion. |
| **Fluoroscopic localization/guidance** | Typically included/bundled with spine instrumentation/fusion procedures and not separately reportable in most settings. Do not separately report **76000/77003** unless payer policy specifically allows and documentation supports distinct diagnostic fluoroscopy. |
| **Removal of prior TLIF cage** | There is no specific CPT code for removal of an interbody cage. **22855** is for removal of anterior instrumentation and would generally not apply to removal of a posteriorly placed TLIF PEEK cage. |

### Recommended CPT Code Set

**22558, 22853, 22845, 20930**

With modifier considerations as applicable:

- **22558-62** if co-surgeon/access surgeon participation is documented and billed by both surgeons.
- Add applicable laterality is not usually needed for spinal level codes.
- Use **22899** only with strong documentation and payer-specific support for difficult prior cage removal.
